title: Model routing got less mysterious
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: sturdier model routing, a repaired app-review pipeline, fresh community listings, and a pile of small fixes that make the machinery less theatrical.

GPT-5.2 mappings were updated, the reasoning endpoint gained a cleaner alias, and Claude response parsing became more resilient. Tool-call tests add a fence around the whole arrangement, because model output remains an adventurous data format.

The app-submission workflow now reacts to labels, uses the authenticated generation endpoint, handles multiline PR bodies correctly, and sends reviews through claude-large. Less workflow archaeology for people submitting things they built.

Highlights from late July through early December were backfilled, while Aqua AI Generator and NextGenTools joined the social and creative app listings.
